headline: The studio now publishes source-dated public metrics, relationship-checked editorial art, trustworthy interaction states, and byte-bound content release continuity.

items.title: Public Analytica became a real surface
items.insight: Eight precomputed metrics carry their own period, denominator, source date, and interpretation, so public evidence stays useful without live-query cost or inflated certainty.

items.title: Reader interactions now tell the truth
items.insight: Navigation focus, hero-choice denominators, and reaction delivery states are verified as observable contracts instead of optimistic interface behavior.

items.title: Content releases gained durable continuity
items.insight: Composite artifact identity now joins baseline, content head, exact path set, workflow run, and served-byte verdict, so a safe overlay no longer looks like a contradictory full deployment.

followUps: Build the claim-evidence relationship map and one-click agent critique packet.
Close field-vitals freshness with observed-through and stale-day truth.
blockers: Full-site production promotion remains held on Obelisk real-provider evidence; the identity-isolated content lane is verified and live.
